Used by CadCraft's renderer (assets/apps/*/dev/render/pt-denoise.js, pt-denoise-gpu.js): our own inference of the network these
weights belong to (a U-Net of 3 × 3 convolutions), written from the format and layer list of Open Image Denoise
(https://github.com/RenderKit/oidn, Apache-2.0). No Open Image Denoise code is included. Decision and measurements:
docs/spikes/RN.5-denoiser.md.
